title: Scheme tests and comparison maps for representable etale morphisms
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and use algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Representable, representable etale, and representable surjective etale have the scheme-test meanings in [def-trf-algebraic-space]; etale and surjective scheme morphisms mean [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-surjective-morphism]. Every morphism $h_U\to F$ from an $S$-scheme $U$ to an algebraic space $F$ is representable. For any two such scheme-source maps $h_U\to F$ and $h_T\to F$, the sheaf $h_U\times_Fh_T$ is represented by a scheme. Representable etale morphisms of algebraic spaces are closed under composition and arbitrary algebraic-space base change, and include all isomorphisms. The same assertions about composition and base change hold for representable surjective etale morphisms, and isomorphisms are representable surjective etale. For a morphism $r:U\to V$ of $S$-schemes, $h_r$ is representable etale if and only if $r$ is etale; a surjective etale scheme morphism induces a representable surjective etale morphism. Finally, let $U,V$ be $S$-schemes, let $F$ be an algebraic space, and let $a:h_U\to F$ and $b:h_V\to F$ be representable etale. Every scheme morphism $r:U\to V$ satisfying $b\circ h_r=a$ is etale. Scheme fibre products use [def-pc-fibre-product]; algebraic-space fibre products are the sheaf fibre products of [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers].

proof.text: Identify IsRepresentable with yoneda.relativelyRepresentable by unpacking the scheme-test witnesses. Mathlib Functor.relativelyRepresentable.of_diag applied to the representable diagonal of F proves that each h_U → F is representable. A represented test square has its canonical isoPullback, whose inverse proves the scheme fibre-product assertion. This is the formal diagonal pullback argument of Tag 025W [def-trf-algebraic-space, def-pc-fibre-product, lem-pc-yoneda].

For any morphism property P of schemes over S respecting isomorphisms, identify IsRepresentableWith P f with P.relative yoneda f. The forward direction is Mathlib relative.of_exists, using uniqueness of representing pullbacks up to isomorphism; the reverse direction extracts its representing square and property_snd. Pull back Etale and Surjective along Over.forget S. Their composition and isomorphism instances, transported through relative, prove the etale and surjective-etale composition clauses and the isomorphism clause [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation, def-weil-surjective-morphism, lem-trf-surjective-morphism-composition].

Over.forget S preserves pullbacks, so scheme base-change stability gives base-change stability of both properties on Over S. Mathlib relative_isStableUnderBaseChange transports these to presheaves. Apply of_isPullback to the sheaf pullback square mapped by sheafToPresheaf, which preserves limits. This proves both base-change assertions without needing to bundle the sheaf pullback as an algebraic space [def-pc-fibre-product, lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits, lem-weil-pbc-surjective-base-change].

Mathlib relative_map_iff gives IsEtale (yoneda.map r) iff Etale r.left: Yoneda is fully faithful and preserves pullbacks, and the scheme property is stable under base change. Apply relative_map separately for Etale and Surjective to prove the surjective-etale scheme-map clause [lem-pc-yoneda, lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits, lem-weil-pbc-surjective-base-change].

For the comparison clause choose the representing scheme of the a-test along b. Its two projections p to U and q to V are etale: q by property_snd for a, p by the flipped representing square and the b-test. The commuting triangle gives the graph-section lift s with s ≫ p = identity and s ≫ q = r by fully faithful Yoneda and the relativelyRepresentable lift API. Etale cancellation on s.left ≫ p.left proves s.left etale; composing with q.left proves r.left etale [lem-pc-yoneda, lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation]. No surjectivity assumption is used.

lean.statement: theorem representable_etale_scheme_tests {S : Scheme.{u}} : (∀ (F : AlgebraicSpace S) (U : Over S) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ F.obj.obj), IsRepresentable a) ∧ (∀ (F : AlgebraicSpace S) (U T : Over S) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ F.obj.obj) (b : yoneda.obj T ⟶ F.obj.obj), ∃ P : Over S, Nonempty (Limits.pullback a b ≅ yoneda.obj P)) ∧ (∀ (A B C : AlgebraicSpace S) (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C), IsEtale f.hom.hom → IsEtale g.hom.hom → IsEtale (f ≫ g).hom.hom) ∧ (∀ (A B C : AlgebraicSpace S) (f : A ⟶ B) (g : C ⟶ B), IsEtale f.hom.hom → IsEtale (Limits.pullback.snd f.hom g.hom).hom) ∧ (∀ (A B : AlgebraicSpace S) (f : A ⟶ B), IsIso f → IsEtale f.hom.hom ∧ IsSurjective f.hom.hom) ∧ (∀ (A B C : AlgebraicSpace S) (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C), IsEtale f.hom.hom → IsSurjective f.hom.hom → IsEtale g.hom.hom → IsSurjective g.hom.hom → IsEtale (f ≫ g).hom.hom ∧ IsSurjective (f ≫ g).hom.hom) ∧ (∀ (A B C : AlgebraicSpace S) (f : A ⟶ B) (g : C ⟶ B), IsEtale f.hom.hom → IsSurjective f.hom.hom → IsEtale (Limits.pullback.snd f.hom g.hom).hom ∧ IsSurjective (Limits.pullback.snd f.hom g.hom).hom) ∧ (∀ (U V : Over S) (r : U ⟶ V), IsEtale (yoneda.map r) ↔ Etale r.left) ∧ (∀ (U V : Over S) (r : U ⟶ V), Etale r.left → Surjective r.left → IsEtale (yoneda.map r) ∧ IsSurjective (yoneda.map r)) ∧ (∀ (F : AlgebraicSpace S) (U V : Over S) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ F.obj.obj) (b : yoneda.obj V ⟶ F.obj.obj) (r : U ⟶ V), IsEtale a → IsEtale b → yoneda.map r ≫ b = a → Etale r.left)
